chapters.label: Level, live
chapters.text: Manchester, 2022. City are drawing with Erling Haaland's old club, Borussia Dortmund. Six minutes left. João Cancelo looks up on the left and floats a cross... Haaland! Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Haaland slips in behind Nico Schlotterbeck, eyes on the ball as it drops towards the far post.

chapters.label: First time!
chapters.text: He leaps, left leg high in the air, and hooks it first time with the outside of his boot, past Alexander Meyer! Two-one!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: make your run early, then hit it first time, before the keeper is set.
